items.description: Email2Go is an online service that helps you create email templates and test them on dozens different physical devices and applications.

SQLify adds data conversion to any third-party application. The API converts JSON data into query-able data (CSV or SQL). SQLify offers full API access for free. A paid plan is also available which offers unlimited row processing and chat support.
A visual Google Maps and Twitter mashup lets you find local updates from local tribunes.
Calculates slope angle and aspect from USGS and Google elevation api's. This information is used by backcountry skiers, split boarders, and snow mobile riders for avalanche safety.

This features the ecological datasets of the Partnership for Interdisciplinary Studies of Coastal Oceans. Users can pick an organism and see its distribution and abundance. Users can also view survey site metadata and species lists.

Use any of the five APIs to access ACTIV's technology: ActivFeed API, ActivContentServer API, ActivServerContribution API, ActivClientContribution API, or ActivMiddleware API. Use the ActivFeed API to get a variety of market data, including current prices, time-series, fundamental data, and news. Use the ActivContentServer API to get multicast streams, and it can accommodate high-bandwidth needs. Contact to obtain documentation.
VCarious is a community-based travel portal. Explore the world via dynamic travel guides, create journals, upload photos, and use other social features.
A real estate site for the Greek market.

SDMX-SAX Faces brings together multiple free SDMX (Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange) data services in one data portal. One of these data services is OECD, which is integrated via the OECD Open Data API.

For restaurants who are tired of keeping customers chained to a small radius with those antiquated pagers. Keeps your waiting list for you and uses text messages to notify customers when their table is ready.
As you type a location, Google Maps Instant centers a map on the best result that is returned from Google's geocoder. The tool is surprisingly good at determining cities based on partial input.

Trello is an online project management and collaboration platform. Users can manage their projects on Trello boards that display the various aspects of their projects, such as what has been done and who is working on what.The Trello API allows developers to access and integrate the data and functionality of Trello with other applications and to create new applications. Some example API methods include retrieving project information, managing user information, and viewing lists and tasks.
